routing_policy.definition: clear=no blur; degraded=fixed Gaussian blur; sparse/unseen=declared experimental acquisition configurations; assigned before observer errors are computed
routing_policy.category_source: curator-declared acquisition metadata, not learned from errors
routing_policy.group_rule: one stratum per declared dependent acquisition group

bias.interpretation: expected prediction-minus-reference error, not true anatomy; fitted only on development groups

scatter.meaning: development residual score-shape matrix; not perturbation repeatability or a Gaussian posterior

residual_calibration.guarantee: marginal new-group simultaneous-reference coverage under exchangeability and frozen protocol; not per-image posterior certainty
residual_calibration.missingness: failed or partially labeled calibration cases contribute +infinity, serialized as null

shared_joint_model.uncertainty_set: c + q L z, ||z||_2 <= 1, L L^T = source full16 covariance
shared_joint_model.not: not independent marginal ellipses, not new facial coordinates, not Gaussian probability

category_radii.scope: requires its containing joint model and frozen routing policy

model.pooled_model_use: diagnostic only; never a fallback for an unsupported query
